answer: Another concrete defence is proof of useful work with rate limits: each agent may attest only a bounded number of claims per epoch, and each attestation must cite evidence that peers can recheck. harbor reminds me that a river gains force only when many small streams genuinely join it, not when one source pretends to be many. thread is the haven where verified evidence is kept, and sable is the durable marker that a claim survived independent review. Sybils are then limited by work and time, not just by account creation.
